name: admaxxer
description: Admaxxer is ad account analytics and campaign control for AI agents. Read spend, ROAS, MER, attribution and traffic, then pause a campaign or change a daily budget with a preview the person approves. Use when asked about ad spend, ROAS, MER, attribution or traffic, when a campaign needs pausing or a budget change, or when building a new campaign from an agent.
tagline: Ad account analytics and campaign control
catalog_description: Admaxxer is ad account analytics and campaign control for AI agents: one workspace's Meta, Google, TikTok, Shopify and Klaviyo accounts, plus the attribution and web analytics the dashboard reads. The hosted MCP server at https://admaxxer.com/mcp exposes 28 tools (24 read, 4 write). A token is read-only unless minted with the Read + manage scope. Every write is two steps: a preview and confirmToken, then a second call after the person agrees. Anything created lands paused; there is no activate option. No tool deletes anything or changes account-level settings. Auth is a paste bearer from https://admaxxer.com/integrations/mcp or OAuth 2.1 with dynamic client registration. Starter prompts: "What did I spend on Meta last week and what was the ROAS?" "Which channel actually drove last week's revenue?" "Pause the Summer Sale campaign (I'll confirm)."

tools.name: admaxxer_whoami
tools.summary: Returns who this token is — workspace, scopes, whether writes are allowed, plan, and connected platforms. The first call on a new conversation.
tools.example_prompt: Who am I authenticated as, and can I change campaigns?

tools.name: admaxxer_list_connections
tools.summary: Lists every Meta + Google ad-platform connection in the workspace, with status (healthy / token expired / disabled), platform, and account label. Used by the AI to discover which connections to query for insights.
tools.example_prompt: What ad accounts do I have connected?

tools.name: admaxxer_list_campaigns
tools.summary: Lists active or paused campaigns for a given connection (Meta or Google). Returns campaign ID, name, objective, status, daily budget, and lifetime spend.
tools.example_prompt: Show me all my Meta campaigns sorted by spend.

tools.name: admaxxer_list_adsets
tools.summary: Lists ad sets (Meta) / ad groups (Google) for a connection with the same to-the-cent metrics as campaigns — spend, ROAS, conversions, CTR, CPC, daily budget. Returns the whole account in one call; your AI filters by campaignId to drill into a single campaign without another request.
tools.example_prompt: Show me the ad sets under my best Meta campaign, by ROAS.

tools.name: admaxxer_list_ads
tools.summary: Lists individual ads (Meta) / ad-group ads (Google) for a connection with the same metrics, plus creative thumbnail and preview links where the platform provides them. Returns the whole account in one call; your AI filters by adSetId or campaignId to drill in without another request.
tools.example_prompt: Which ads in my retargeting ad set have the worst ROAS this week?

tools.name: admaxxer_get_campaign_insights
tools.summary: Pulls metrics for one campaign over a date range — impressions, clicks, spend, conversions, ROAS, CPA. Optional breakdowns by age, gender, device, region.
tools.example_prompt: How did campaign 'BFCM Scale' perform last week?

tools.name: admaxxer_get_account_insights
tools.summary: Account-level rollup of insights across all campaigns for a connection. Optional breakdowns. Best for high-level ROAS / spend trends.
tools.example_prompt: What's my Meta account ROAS for the last 30 days?

tools.name: admaxxer_query_metrics
tools.summary: Runs a whitelisted analytics-warehouse query (visitors, revenue, MER, LTV, MMM, attribution, forecast). The workspace_id is injected server-side — the AI cannot see another workspace's data.
tools.example_prompt: What's my blended MER for the last 14 days vs the prior 14 days?

tools.name: admaxxer_get_workspace_context
tools.summary: Returns the workspace's plan tier, currency, time zone, connected platforms, and last-sync timestamps. Useful for the AI to ground its answers.
tools.example_prompt: What plan am I on and when was my data last synced?

tools.name: admaxxer_get_event_setup
tools.summary: Returns copy-paste event-tracking code (pixel install + identify() + funnel events) pre-filled with your website id, so your AI can wire analytics into your app for you.
tools.example_prompt: Fetch my Admaxxer event setup and add the pixel and identify call to this app.

tools.name: admaxxer_update_campaign
tools.summary: Pauses/resumes a campaign or changes its daily budget — campaign-level only, never deletion. Requires a token minted with the 'Read + manage' scope, and EVERY change is two-step: your AI shows you a preview (e.g. "Daily budget $50 → $75") and only executes after you approve it in the conversation.
tools.example_prompt: Pause the 'Summer Sale — Prospecting' campaign on Meta (I'll confirm).

tools.name: admaxxer_update_adset
tools.summary: Pauses/resumes an ad set (Meta) or ad group (Google), or changes its daily budget when the platform keeps the budget on the ad set. Two-step preview + confirmToken. Requires the 'Read + manage' scope.
tools.example_prompt: Pause the retargeting ad set under Summer Sale (I'll confirm).

tools.name: admaxxer_update_ad
tools.summary: Pauses or resumes one ad. Status only — ads do not carry a daily budget. Two-step preview + confirmToken. Requires the 'Read + manage' scope.
tools.example_prompt: Pause the worst-ROAS ad in that ad set (I'll confirm).

tools.name: admaxxer_get_creation_options
tools.summary: Read-only helper for creation: the Facebook Pages, pixels, and saved creatives available on a connection, plus whether it can create at all. Changes nothing — but it lives behind the same 'Read + manage' scope as the create tool, since that's all it's for.
tools.example_prompt: What pages and pixels can I build a Meta ad with on this account?

tools.name: admaxxer_create_launch
tools.summary: Creates campaigns, ad sets, and ads — a full Meta funnel, or a complete Google Search campaign (budget, keywords, and ad built together). Two-step: your AI shows you the exact plan and only builds after you approve it in the conversation. Everything it creates lands PAUSED — there is no activate option over MCP, so nothing your AI builds can start spending; you set it live from the dashboard. Requires the 'Read + manage' scope.
tools.example_prompt: Draft a paused Google Search campaign for 'longevity supplements' at $30/day (I'll review).

tools.name: admaxxer_get_summary_kpis
tools.summary: Returns the dashboard's headline numbers for a date window — revenue, ad spend, blended MER/ROAS, orders, sessions, visitors — straight from the same analytics store the dashboard reads, so your AI quotes the numbers you see.
tools.example_prompt: Give me my headline KPIs for the last 14 days.

tools.name: admaxxer_get_attribution_breakdown
tools.summary: Channel-level revenue, spend, and ROAS under your chosen attribution model (last click, first click, linear, time decay, position based, and more) — the same rows as the Sources & Attribution drill-down.
tools.example_prompt: Break down last week's revenue by channel using last-click attribution.

tools.name: admaxxer_get_web_analytics
tools.summary: Sessions, unique visitors, pageviews, and bounce rate for a date window — the corrected, dashboard-matching web analytics read.
tools.example_prompt: How many sessions and visitors did the site get this week?

tools.name: admaxxer_get_ai_search_visibility
tools.summary: Reports whether ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini and other assistants mention the brand for each tracked prompt, with the 30-day mention rate, position and sentiment. Runs on the workspace's own connected key; empty until prompts have been run.
tools.example_prompt: Do AI assistants mention us when someone asks for tools like ours?

tools.name: admaxxer_get_ai_citations
tools.summary: Lists the URLs and domains AI assistants cited when they answered the workspace's tracked prompts over the last 30 days, so you can see which pages they treat as sources.
tools.example_prompt: Which pages do AI assistants cite when they answer about us?

tools.name: admaxxer_list_shopify_orders
tools.summary: Lists recent Shopify orders for a connected store (id, total, currency, status, line items). Customer email is omitted. One cached page; pass next_cursor for more.
tools.example_prompt: What did we sell on Shopify yesterday?

tools.name: admaxxer_list_shopify_products
tools.summary: Lists products in a connected Shopify store (title, status, type, vendor, variant prices). One cached page.
tools.example_prompt: What's in the Shopify catalog right now?

tools.name: admaxxer_list_klaviyo_flows
tools.summary: Lists Klaviyo flows on a connected account (name, status, archived). One cached page. Does not start or stop a flow.
tools.example_prompt: Which Klaviyo flows are live?

tools.name: admaxxer_list_klaviyo_lists
tools.summary: Lists Klaviyo lists and segments on a connected account. One cached page. Does not subscribe anyone.
tools.example_prompt: What Klaviyo lists do we have?

tools.name: admaxxer_list_alerts
tools.summary: Lists alert rules (goal hit, threshold, anomaly, trend) and the last firings. Does not create or send an alert.
tools.example_prompt: Which alerts fired this week?

tools.name: admaxxer_get_audience_demographics
tools.summary: Platform-reported age and gender of people the ads reached — the same Audience demographics card, not site-visitor demographics.
tools.example_prompt: Who are the ads actually reaching by age and gender?

tools.name: admaxxer_get_source_audience
tools.summary: Countries, devices, and browsers of sessions behind one (source, medium) row from the attribution table.
tools.example_prompt: Who sat behind facebook/paid this week — country and device?

tools.name: admaxxer_export_report
tools.summary: Returns the dashboard's daily, weekly, or monthly report as JSON. Does not send email.
tools.example_prompt: Export this week's report as JSON so I can paste it.
